title: Reward misalignment as an opportunity for materials discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.26186v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reward misalignment is usually regarded as a failure of artificial intelligence. In materials discovery with generative AI models, however, disagreement between predefined rewards and expert judgment may reveal materials that the rewards overlook. We investigate this possibility using electronic flat bands as a prime example. Experts mostly agree with a numerical bandwidth score, but their disagreements are systematic and cannot be explained by an estimated 5% rate of mistaken labels. We learn the experts' preferences from pairwise comparisons and use them to guide a crystal diffusion model. The learned preferences and numerical score agree on the flattest bands but diverge elsewhere. For example, the preferences favor KCo2As2 and CoGa, reported compounds with partially flat bands that the score would discard. The framework also extends to synthesizability and phonon properties. translated_title: 奖励错位作为材料发现的机遇
translated_abstract: 奖励错位通常被视为人工智能的一种失败。然而，在利用生成式AI模型进行材料发现时，预定义奖励与专家判断之间的分歧可能揭示出奖励所忽略的材料。我们以电子平带为主要例子来研究这种可能性。专家们大多认同数值带宽评分，但他们之间的分歧是系统性的，且无法用估计约5%的错误标注率来解释。我们从成对比较中学习专家的偏好，并用其指导晶体扩散模型。学习到的偏好与数值评分在最平坦的能带上达成一致，但在其他情况下则出现分歧。例如，偏好倾向于KCo2As2和CoGa——这些已报道的具有部分平坦能带的化合物会被评分所淘汰。该框架还可以扩展到可合成性和声子性质。我们的研究结果表明，奖励错位可以揭示……
tldr: 该研究提出，生成式AI材料发现中奖励函数与专家判断的错位并非失败，而是发现被奖励遗漏的新材料（如具有部分平坦能带的化合物）的机遇。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that reward misalignment in generative AI materials discovery, rather than being a failure, can serve as an opportunity to uncover materials overlooked by predefined rewards, such as reported compounds with partially flat electronic bands.
